title: Design: The $0 confirmation looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • At least two customers are on Net 7.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p2-07-confirm-the-0-limits.png, ct-p2-08-cancel-keeps-the-choices.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 7 row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Move {n} Customers".
  4. Click "Cancel".
  5. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens.
  • Step 2: the "Move Customers from Net 7" window opens with "Move To" reading COD.
  • Step 3: a window opens over the Move window (as in ct-p2-07-confirm-the-0-limits.png): the bold title "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?", the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move.", and "Cancel" then a red "Set Limits To $0 And Move". The Cancel style: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.
  • Step 4: the confirmation closes and the Move window shows the same ticks and Move To as before (as in ct-p2-08-cancel-keeps-the-choices.png).
  • Step 5: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

{n} is the number of customers on Net 7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R14: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, pressing "Move {n} Customers" first opens a confirmation titled "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" for one), with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed as "Set Limits To $0 And Move").”
  • S4-R15: “"Cancel" in that confirmation returns to the Move Customers window with the search, ticks and "Move To" choice kept.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move to COD or Credit Hold pressed | "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?") / "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." | Confirmation, buttons "Cancel" (back to the window, choices kept) and red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed "Set Limits To $0 And Move")”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Confirm the $0 limits", "Cancel keeps the choices").   • “Rendered from the local build after Cancel: back in the Move Customers window with the search, ticks (14 selected) and Move To kept (S4-R15). Nothing is moved or logged.”
